newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: SOCCER-MUGEYI WINS TWO SAFRICAN AWARDS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-MUGEYI WINS TWO SAFRICAN AWARDS.

text.p: Zimbabwean striker Wilfred Mugeyi walked off with both South Africa's footballer of the year and player's player of the year awards at Tuesday's end-of-season presentation in Johannesburg.
The international striker, who plays for Umtata Bucks, was also the South African league's leading goalscorer with 22 goals and won more than $20 000 in prize money for his efforts.

Newly crowned league champions Manning Rangers also received their medals at the presentation. Durban-based Rangers won their first championship ahead of second-placed Kaizer Chiefs and Orlando Pirates in third spot.
